covenants.quote: 9.1 The Borrower shall ensure that the Interest Coverage Ratio does not fall below 2.50 times.
9.2 The Borrower shall maintain Minimum Liquidity of not less than INR 40 crore in unencumbered cash at all times.
9.3 The ratio of Total Debt to Net Worth shall not be more than 1.50 times.
10.1 The Borrower shall maintain insurance over its plants with reputable insurers and keep the policies in force.
10.2 The Borrower shall not sell, transfer or otherwise dispose of any of its assets, other than assets having a value not exceeding INR 25 crore in any Financial Year.
